The user asks: "Our CFO asked me to confirm bank transfer is supported before she approves the annual plan — can you confirm either way?" This is about whether bank transfer is supported for annual plan. According to DOC-005 part 2: "Annual contracts can also be paid by bank transfer against an invoice, which is arranged through support before the contract starts rather than self-served from the billing settings — bank transfer requires setting the account up for invoiced billing rather than automatic card charges." Also DOC-005 part 3 says monthly plans are card-only; a workspace wanting bank transfer needs to be on an annual term first. So answer: Yes, bank transfer is supported for annual contracts, arranged via support before contract starts, need invoiced billing. Provide that info. No need to escalate. Provide short answer.
